ui.agents.skills.alert.builtin_body: It ships with Local Operator and can't be changed here. Copy it to your skills to get a version you can edit or ask an agent to change.

ui.agents.skills.alert.project_body: It belongs to a project folder and changes with that project. Change it there, or copy it to your skills.
